crossRefs.note: She said, “As Yahweh your God lives, I don’t have a cake, but a handful of meal in a jar, and a little oil in a jar.…
Say, ‘The king says, “Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of…
For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
Then I said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! Behold, my soul has not been polluted; for from my youth up even until now I have not…
Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem. They will eat bread by…
“Son of man, eat your bread with quaking, and drink your water with trembling and with fearfulness.
Tell the people of the land, ‘The Lord Yahweh says concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the land of Israel…
I ate no pleasant bread. No meat or wine came into my mouth. I didn’t anoint myself at all, until three whole weeks…

translations.web: My soul refuses to touch them. They are as loathsome food to me.
translations.bsb: My soul refuses to touch them; they are loathsome food to me.
translations.kjv: The things that my soul refused to touch are as my sorrowful meat.
translations.asv: My soul refuseth to touch them; They are as loathsome food to me.
